edition_language_conflict.assessment: ISBN 9784309923093 is tied to Japanese-language metadata in the national library record and to Japanese publisher/retailer listings released in June 2026, while the PIE international page describes an 'English version' carrying the same ISBN with a later 2027-10-05 release date. Supplied sources cannot establish whether PIE denotes a distinct English edition reusing the ISBN, a future reissue, or an erroneous page. The conflict must not be declared resolved and no edition may be represented as a confirmed English edition. Only the June 2026 Japanese-documented edition is evidenced in the supply records observed.

classification_rationale: Identity of ISBN 9784309923093 as the Sorayama art book is corroborated by a national library catalog, a publisher catalog, and a Japanese retail offer, so outright rejection is not warranted. However, qualified status requires Mainland P evidence, complete K, and fulfillment support: no Mainland transaction or buyer offer was found, K and both 50% tests are unknown, max purchase price is null, and the edition/language conflict is unresolved. The item therefore remains a research lead only; no observed fact justifies upgrading it.
upgrade_conditions: A verified Mainland buyer offer or comparable transaction for this exact ISBN/edition establishing a conservative P in CNY.
A complete landed-cost K in CNY covering fx/payment, cross-border freight, tax, platform fees, domestic postage, packing, and after-sales reserve.
A documented fulfillment path with delivery confidence into the Mainland.
Resolution of the Japanese-vs-English language and release-date conflict via publisher/distributor confirmation or physical-copy inspection.
